subject: Sourcing: Cirrus AI onboarding — purchase reference issuance & line item correction
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@cirrusai.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cirrusai.com
Date: 2026-04-19T08:12:00Z
Subject: Purchase reference request + onboarding form (Cirrus AI)

Hi Markus —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We're ready to move forward with Redwood for inference routing on our EU cluster. To complete procurement we need:

- A formal purchase reference (PO-like number) to include on our side
- Confirmed spend cap for Q2 (we agreed to a pilot cap of EUR 50k)
- The onboarding form attached with billing contact filled out
- A simple line-item split that shows dev vs prod usage so our finance team can code correctly

I attached our filled Cirrus_Onboard_Form_v3.pdf and a preliminary lineitems-cirrus-2026-04.xlsx (dev/prod split). Can you issue the purchase reference and confirm the spend cap so we can open the internal ticket FYI?

Best,
Maria Lopez
Head of Procurement — Cirrus AI

Attachments: Cirrus_Onboard_Form_v3.pdf (application/pdf), lineitems-cirrus-2026-04.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@cirrusai.com>
Date: 2026-04-19T10:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Purchase reference request + onboarding form (Cirrus AI)

Ben / Laura —

Looping you in to get procurement to issue the purchase reference and lock the Q2 spend cap. Key points from Maria: pilot cap EUR 50k, need a purchase-ref that their AP team can reference, and they prefer two line items (DEV / PROD) so cost center mapping is straightforward.

Ben: can you generate a provisional purchase-ref (prefixed RD) and confirm whether we should create two ledger line items under the same ref or issue separate refs? If separate refs are required for dev/prod we need to note spend caps per ref.

Laura: if procurement needs anything else from Cirrus (tax forms, W9/EU vat docs), please advise.

I'll hold off external confirmation until we have the exact ref and the line-item mapping.

Thanks —
Markus
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@cirrusai.com>
Date: 2026-04-19T13:37:00Z
Subject: Re: Purchase reference request + onboarding form (Cirrus AI)

Markus / Laura / Maria —

Thanks for the details. I created a provisional purchase reference: RD-3492-PR1 and assigned the pilot spend cap EUR 50,000 to that ref.

Notes and decisions made:
- Single purchase reference RD-3492-PR1 to cover the pilot (Cirrus requested single ref for faster AP matching).
- We will split the cost internally into two invoice lines (DEV / PROD) under the same PR for ledger reasons. DEV will have a soft internal cap of EUR 8,000, PROD EUR 42,000 (these are cooperative caps, Redwood will not auto-block charges but will alert at 80% usage).
- Attachment updated with the PR and spend caps (see attached lineitems-cirrus-2026-04.xlsx, tab 'PR_update').

Action items:
- Maria: confirm that single PR + internal line split satisfies Cirrus AP. If you absolutely need separate PRs per cost center we can issue RD-3492-DEV and RD-3492-PROD instead but that will add one more onboarding ticket on our side.
- Laura: will you check VAT documentation? Maria, if you can share EU VAT or invoice contact we can finalize procurement compliance.

I'll mark the PR as provisional until we have final VAT completion.

Best,
Ben Carter
Vendor Enablement — Redwood Inference

Attachment: lineitems-cirrus-2026-04.xlsx (updated: tab PR_update)

From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@cirrusai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cirrusai.com, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-20T15:23:00Z
Subject: Re: Purchase reference request + onboarding form (Cirrus AI)

Thanks Ben — RD-3492-PR1 works for our AP team and the single-ref approach is preferred. The DEV/PROD internal split is fine; we'll mirror that in our GL: DEV 8k / PROD 42k.

Quick correction: the line-item spreadsheet had the PROD SKU listed as "inference-production" but our purchasing code expects "inference-runtime-prod". Attached updated sheet with exact SKUs. Can you confirm the PR record will be amended to reflect the SKU tag change so invoices map automatically?

Also sending our VAT registration number in a separate email for Laura.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — excited to get the pilot underway.

—Maria
